title: Bug: Fix instantiation for pddf current sensor
author: michaelc-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

See: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/22444#discussion_r2142117886
There is a typo in the constructor for pddf_current_sensor. 

### Steps to Reproduce

Add a pddf current sensor in the pddf-device.json 

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

PDDF current sensors should be properly instantiated.
